summary: The filing reports amendments to three existing warrants held by Streeterville Capital, lowering the reduced exercise price from $6.00 to $4.00 per share and extending the reduced-price period to July 27, 2026. The company may terminate this period on two days' notice, reverting to the original Nasdaq Valuation Price. This is a routine warrant repricing and extension, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is involved. The filing also announces a fiscal-year-end earnings conference call.
